comments:
Listed in the group of Phya pa (ID:3831)'s students called "the four wise ones" (shes rab can mi bzhi), comprising 'Gar dBang grub (ID:3851), Khong po 'Jag chung (ID:3852), lHo pa sGog zan (ID:3853), and sPar phu ba (ID:3854), and among "the three wise ones" (shes rab can mi gsum), comprising Khong po 'Jag chung (ID:3852), lHo pa sGog zan (ID:3853), and sPar phu ba (ID:3854).

gSer mdog Paṇ chen gives the alternative name of sGom gzan "lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa" in [8GL7ZT7Y]: 15b4 and the same and "lho pa dha r[m]a seng" in [VKBZTBWN]: 5a1. Based on the latter, [E8PSX9S8]: 11, n. 16 considers that he is the same person as Sa skya paṇḍita's student Lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal (ID:5463).
